name: patchdiff
description: Server-side deterministic, atomic, preconditioned document transaction engine exposed over the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

tools.name: patchdiff_submit_edits
tools.description: Submit atomic guarded typed edits (patchdiff-tx/1) against a target document managed in PostgreSQL.

tools.name: patchdiff_submit_operations
tools.description: Submit ordered guarded match/span operations (patchdiff-tx/2) against a target document.

tools.name: patchdiff_submit_replacement
tools.description: Submit an explicit guarded whole-target replacement (patchdiff-tx/3).

tools.name: patchdiff_read_target
tools.description: Read authoritative UTF-8 slices of a target document by code-point offset and length.

tools.name: patchdiff_read_lines
tools.description: Read authoritative inclusive line ranges of a target document with range-relative pagination.

tools.name: patchdiff_find_occurrences
tools.description: Search for exact occurrences of text in a target document with surrounding context and pagination.

tools.name: patchdiff_preview
tools.description: Advisory in-memory dry-run of a transaction proposal without acquiring row locks or advancing target state.

tools.name: patchdiff_save
tools.description: Checkpoint current target state and rotate the active editing cycle.

tools.name: patchdiff_replay
tools.description: Deterministically reconstruct and verify target state across recorded execution profiles.

tools.name: patchdiff_get_pdcp_log
tools.description: Query the append-only attempt log for accepted and rejected transaction proposals.

tools.name: patchdiff_get_manifest_ledger
tools.description: Query the accepted-only manifest ledger with runtime-derived span and hash facts.
